text.description_html:
Emtek 1371, 1.5 x 11 Arched Concord Multi Point Handleset with American Cylinder Above Handle

The Multi-Point Trim 1-1/2 x 11 Inch American Cylinder Above Handle has a 4-1/8 Inch c.c. lock to lever distance and 8-1/2 inch mounting centers. The Brass Concord Configuration #3 Patio Trim is for use on patio doors with a multipoint lock mechanism already installed. This patio door handleset features an American cylinder above the lever. It will fit doors 1-5/8 inches to 2-3/4 inches thick. The Arched Concord Multi Point Handleset with American Cylinder Above Handle is customizable. Choose your lever and finish color from a wide array of choices ranging from classic to contemporary for a look that is all your own.

This multipoint trim set is intended to replace the trim from Andersen brand patio doors. The lock to lever distance is 4-1/8 (105 mm). This set does NOT come packaged with the multipoint lock mechanism (the vertical rods found in multipoint patio doors that secure the door to the frame) as those are typically preinstalled in multipoint doors and cannot be replaced.

Features and Specifications of the Brass Concord Multi Point Trim with Door Configuration #3:

  • Overall Height: 11"
  • Overall Width: 1-1/2"
  • Distance Between Trim and Cylinder or Thumbturn: 4-1/8"
  • Mounting Centers: 8-1/2"
  • Plate Thickness: 3/8"
  • Door Thickness: 1-5/8" - 2-3/4" please specify.
  • Solid steel spindle.

Available Functions:

  • Dummy Pair, Active (inside): Active lever inside with fixed inactive lever outside. For use as a pull or to match trim. Normally used on inactive French door. Set includes: Two (2) backplates, Two (2) levers with spindles and mounting screws.
  • Dummy Pair, Inactive: Fixed inactive levers both sides of door. For use as a pull or to match trim. Normally used on inactive French door. Set includes: Two (2) backplates, Two (2) levers with spindles and mounting screws.
  • Passage: Active levers both sides of door. Set includes: Two (2) backplates, Two (2) levers with spindles, and mounting screws.
  • Patio: Active levers both sides of door. Thumb turn inside to lock door. Set includes: Two (2) backplates, Two (2) levers with spindles, One (1) interior thumb turn and mounting screws.
  • Keyed Entry: Active levers both sides of door. Keyed lock cylinder outside with thumb turn inside to lock door. Set includes: Two (2) backplates, Two (2) levers with spindles, Two (2) cylinder collars, One (1) american profile cylinder with key outside & thumb turn inside and mounting screws.

Choose any of the different levers to complete your handleset.
